patthana15.32:1.1: Noāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.32:2.1: Āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.32:3.1: Noāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nanoāsavo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
